dct_creator_sm: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of the Census, Geography Division
dct_description_sm: This datalayer displays water bodies for Arizona. This category includes lakes, ponds, ditches, aqueducts, tanks, rivers, reservoirs and other water features. Predominant features represented in this layer have Census Feature Class Codes (CFCCs) of: H01 (Shoreline of perennial water feature); H11 (Perennial stream or river); H12 (Intermittent stream, river, or wash); H21 (Perennial canal, ditch, or aqueduct); H31 (Perennial lake or pond); H32 (Intermittent lake or pond); H41 (Perennial reservoir). The Feature Name attribute further identifies water bodies.
